stay free. Rev A builds: move W54 to the GND rail @49.
Check J1/J2, then R5, C2, DS1, W23-W27.

5 V coils won't hold on a Li-ion cell:
boost rail or 3 V-coil relays (wiring.md s8)
NSK XRC runs 12 V on pin 1: never wire it
to the Pico directly. Isolate both ways:
• Where to tap the shared I2C1 bus (GP6 SDA / GP7 SCL): B1 holes i14 and i15 (Pico
strips), or the OLED strips c55 / c56.
• Total bus pull-up: the OLED module already has some; add 4.7k to 3V3 only if a scope
shows slow edges with RTC + gauge fitted.
• microSD (Adafruit 254): CLK ← GP10 (i19), DI ← GP11 (i20), DO → GP12 (i21), CS ←
• RTC eval board: 3V3, GND, SDA, SCL (+ INT/CLKOUT optional). pins.h says RV-3028-C7;
the part ordered is the -C8 eval board.
• Fuel gauge: CELL/VIN to the LiPo, GND common, SDA/SCL to the bus. ALRT optional
• Keep relay coil current in the battery budget: about 2 x 30 mA while running.
Verify before power-up (not settled by wiring.md)
• Relays: wiring.md names Omron G6K-2P-5VDC; the parts ordered are G5V-2-H1 5VDC. This
layout uses the G5V-2 terminal numbers (coil 1-16, COM 4/13, NC 6/11, NO 8/9). Meter
• OLED address: firmware probes 0x3C only; Adafruit 938 defaults to 0x3D unless DC
(SA0) is low. W27 grounds DC. J1/J2 state depends on board revision.
• TFT header order and joystick pin letters are from Adafruit's guide / the ALPS data
sheet it cites, not from the boards in hand.
• Pico 2 debug connector: 3-pin 0.1" header or JST-SH depending on the variant; pick
